import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 998244353;
    static ArrayList<Long>[] pos = new ArrayList[10];
    static long cnt2 = -1;
    static long n;
    static long[] pw = new long[15];
    static long[] s = new long[15];
    static int result = 0;
    static int total_count = 0;

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
            pos[i] = new ArrayList<>();
        }
        n = Long.parseLong(br.readLine());
        for (int i = 0; i < 7; i++) {
            Collections.sort(pos[i]);
        }
        pw[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i < 13; i++) {
            pw[i] = pw[i - 1] * 10;
        }

        // Define query function
        class Query {
            long apply(int fixpre, int val) {
                long total = 0;
                for (int d = 0; d < 7; d++) {
                    long offset = (val - fixpre * pw[d]) % MOD;
                    if (offset < 0) offset += MOD;
                    int p = lowerBound(pos[d], MOD - offset);
                    long size = pos[d].size();
                    total = (total + s[d] + offset * size - MOD * (size - p)) % MOD;
                }
                return total;
            }
        }
        Query queryObj = new Query();

        // DFS to generate numbers
        class DFS {
            void run(long val, int d) {
                int x = (int)((total_count - val + MOD) % MOD);
                pos[d].add((long) x);
                total_count++;
                s[d] += x;
                if (d == 6) return;
                for (int i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                    run(val * 10 + i, d + 1);
                }
            }
        }
        DFS dfsObj = new DFS();

        // DFS2 to process
        class DFS2 {
            void run(long val) {
                if (val * 1000000 + 999999 <= n && val * 10000000 > n) {
                    result = (int)((result + queryObj.apply((int)val, cnt2 + 1)) % MOD);
                    cnt2 += total_count;
                } else {
                    cnt2++;
                    result = (result + (int)((((cnt2 - val) % MOD) + MOD) % MOD)) % MOD;
                    for (int i = (val != 0 ? 0 : 1); i < 10; i++) {
                        if (val * 10 + i <= n) {
                            run(val * 10 + i);
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        DFS2 dfs2Obj = new DFS2();

        // Run DFS to generate numbers
        dfsObj.run(0, 0);
        // Run DFS2 to process
        dfs2Obj.run(0);
        System.out.println(result);
    }

    static int lowerBound(List<Long> list, long key) {
        int low = 0, high = list.size();
        while (low < high) {
            int mid = (low + high) / 2;
            if (list.get(mid) >= key) {
                high = mid;
            } else {
                low = mid + 1;
            }
        }
        return low;
    }
}
